source_anchors.purpose: LoadInfoDict iterates all property-capable partition names, including optional partitions.
Read properties with existing etc/build.prop priority and root-level fallback; an absent partition now returns empty with a warning.
Keep the ordered canonical and nested paths while supporting extracted directories, ZIP paths and open ZipFile objects.

limitations: This separate patch is not admitted by the current recovery and mi_ext composed-source contracts. Their unchanged common.py identity remains required until a new explicit reviewed composition is selected.
The behavioral probe reads the full hash-bound common.py but executes only its property reader, partition mapper and original standard-library byte-reading helpers against synthetic inputs.
An absent optional property is still absent. Required vendor and ODM metadata, VINTF inputs and actual shipping API remain independent admission checks.
Opaque vendor and ODM images require a native, image-bound metadata projection before target-files packaging; this patch neither supplies that projection nor certifies it.
Nezha has a real vendor/odm_dlkm/etc/build.prop inside vendor despite no separate odm_dlkm partition. Preserve its nested path rather than inventing ODM_DLKM.
Property import parsing is unchanged, including its existing nested-partition import limitation. No regional, SKU or hardware-version property value is inferred.
A successful Python branch probe is not a full target-files, VINTF, AVB, OTA or hardware result.
